description: This file defines API routes for managing blog posts in a web application using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting blog posts, with database interactions via SQLAlchemy ORM models, and user authentication dependencies.

classes.name: BlogPost
classes.description: Response model for blog post data returned to clients.

methods.name: create_post( post: BlogPostCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handle POST request to create a new blog post.

methods.name: get_posts( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, category: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handle GET request to retrieve a list of blog posts with optional filters.

methods.name: get_post(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handle GET request to retrieve a specific blog post by ID.

methods.name: update_post( post_id: int, post_update: BlogPostUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handle PUT request to update an existing blog post.

methods.name: delete_post( post_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handle DELETE request to delete a blog post.
